name: stem-stretch
title: Stem Stretch
desc: The stems of '4 hours' stretch into vertical stripes with a gradient glow, small caption below.

name: stepper
title: UI Stepper
desc: A horizontal onboarding stepper whose progress is a pure function of a continuous step index (value-channel deviation). Every circle (fill, number, stroke-dash check) and connector (primary fill fraction) derives purely from the float position; useStepperTransition reads the frame and eases position between step indices.

name: stock-scrub
title: Stock Scrub
desc: A phone stock page scrubs its price chart then opens a buy sheet.

name: stop-motion
title: Stop Motion Clock
desc: Quantized stop-motion clock for Remotion. Stepped frames, stepped springs, deterministic hashing, and per-pose paper jitter.

name: story-dip
title: Story Dip
desc: Timestamped story lines, "Leo's film was one render away.", drift across the frame.

name: story-text
title: Story Text
desc: Story-style text types in word by word on rounded gradient highlight bubbles.

name: streak-reward
title: Streak Reward
desc: A learning app shows Lesson complete with stat badges and a Continue button.

name: streamgraph
title: Streamgraph
desc: Flowing stacked layers draw across the frame and settle into a 48% share.

name: stretch-in
title: Stretch In
desc: Letters fly in from off-canvas and smear horizontally on the way — a vertex-lag deformation, not a scale.

name: strikethrough-replace
title: Strikethrough Replace
desc: Draws a strike line across old text then reveals new text in its place.

name: string-art
title: String Art
desc: Threads string a ring of pins times-table style while the multiplier morphs from cardioid to nephroid and beyond.

name: stripe-count
title: Stripe Count
desc: A huge 184 counts up on an orange band with a dark bold number and a caption above.

name: stripe-mask
title: Stripe Mask
desc: Slanted stripes mask a two-sentence bold headline into view.

name: stripe-type
title: Stripe Type
desc: A word cut into horizontal bands, as in the IBM logo, slides together from alternating sides and locks, then can pass on through.

name: strobe-montage
title: Strobe Montage
desc: A fast strobe montage of frames flickers between two scenes, landing on a prompt box.

name: strobe-words
title: Strobe Words
desc: Big words strobe in at a set rhythm over a dark horizon glow, ending on the logo.

name: studio-reflection
title: Studio Reflection
desc: A chrome-gradient 250+ appears with studio-style reflection and a small caption.

name: sustained-glitch
title: Sustained Glitch
desc: Broadcast corruption held over a scene in scheduled bursts: slices tear sideways, channels split, and blocks fill with picture pulled from somewhere else — then the frame rests clean until the next hit.

name: swipe-deck
title: Swipe Deck
desc: A swipe card deck lands an Its a match screen with an install prompt.

name: swirl-dissolve
title: Swirl Dissolve
desc: A swirl shader transition that unwinds open and winds shut to reveal the next scene.

name: switch
title: UI Switch
desc: A switch whose checked/unchecked state is a pure function of the timeline; the track fill and sliding thumb are keyframed presets.

name: synthwave
title: Synthwave
desc: A retro neon horizon: a scrolling perspective grid, a rising striped sun and mountain ranges that slide in.

name: t-minus
title: T Minus
desc: A mission clock ticks T-minus with rolling characters, then slams 'LIFTOFF' over a sunrise glow.

name: table-filter
title: Table Filter
desc: A CRM table filters and selects rows, then a bulk-action bar slides up.

name: tabs
title: UI Tabs
desc: A tabs widget whose active-tab state is a pure function of the timeline; the sliding indicator, label colors, and panel crossfade are keyframed/derived presets.

name: tagline-justify
title: Tagline Justify
desc: A tagline sets itself into a justified column with an italic gradient word.

name: tall-count
title: Tall Count
desc: A tall condensed orange-gradient +240% counts up beside a three-line caption.

name: tally-marks
title: Tally Marks
desc: Hand-drawn tally marks fill rows until they resolve into the 1,240 count.

name: tategaki-turn
title: Tategaki Turn
desc: Vertical Japanese-style text turns upright into a horizontal line, 'Read it both ways.'.

name: telegram-chat-flow
title: UI Telegram Chat Flow
desc: A Telegram-styled messaging composition: tailed bubbles (white incoming, blue outgoing) with in-bubble timestamps and delivery checks, a header that flips to 'typing…' while the other side replies, reaction chips, and a Telegram composer that types the outgoing message before sending. Self-contained — it owns its timeline and only composes the caret primitive.

name: terminal-cursor-zoom
title: Terminal Cursor Zoom
desc: Camera locked to the typing cursor, dollying across a terminal as a command types at high zoom.

name: terminal-simulator
title: Terminal Simulator
desc: Terminal window that types out commands and rolls old lines off the top.

name: testimonial-stack
title: Testimonial Stack
desc: A social post card with a highlighted line stacks in with other testimonials.

name: the-tab
title: The Tab
desc: A receipt of dotted lines prices every item at $0, totalling "one Sunday morning".

name: theme-flip
title: Theme Flip
desc: A product UI flips between dark and light themes with a cursor trigger.

name: they-are-you
title: They Are You
desc: Three "You ..." lines in orange and white describe the viewer on a purple ground.

name: thin-slab
title: Thin Slab
desc: A big '1 day' contrasted with a thin progress slab labeled 14x faster than by hand.

name: thread-weave
title: Thread Weave
desc: A number is woven thread by thread on a loom of cream cells in blue and orange.

name: three-steps
title: Three Steps
desc: Three large gradient numerals light along a connecting line: Install, Compose, Render.

name: ticker-tape
title: Ticker Tape
desc: A stock-style ticker symbol with price and green percent change over a scrolling tape.

name: tile-snake-loader
title: Tile Snake Loader
desc: Media tiles snake across a loader and settle into a studio landing page with a hero video card.

name: tile-wave
title: Tile Wave
desc: A wave of tiles flips across the frame, swapping headline for scene on a stage.

name: tilt-settle-list
title: Tilt Settle List
desc: A tilted player card settles beside a ranked list of top scenes.

name: time-breakdown
title: Time Breakdown
desc: A segmented time bar shrinks while 56% less time per video counts up.

name: timeline-editor
title: Timeline Editor
desc: A video editor with a timeline, inspector and export progress panel.

name: timer-duel
title: Timer Duel
desc: Two stopwatch timers run side by side, the faster one ending on 38x faster.

name: times-turn
title: Times Turn
desc: A multiplication sign flips on an orange panel next to a large 3 with a caption.

name: timing-tower
title: Timing Tower
desc: A racing timing tower reorders until the hero car sits at a big P1 with a gap time.

name: tiny-planet
title: Tiny Planet
desc: A seeded flat skyline bends into a tiny planet through a polar remap, then slowly spins beside a red sun.

name: title-converge
title: Title Converge
desc: Each letter drifts in on its own path and converges into the logo between two rules.

name: tittle-drop
title: Tittle Drop
desc: Dots of the i and j drop in last onto 'Ship it in minutes.' on a light ground.

name: tldr-on-top
title: Tldr on Top
desc: A TL;DR summary sits on top of a long body paragraph that fades off.

name: toast
title: UI Toast
desc: A toast notification whose hidden/visible state is a pure function of the timeline. The Toast renderer is a pure function of a ToastStyle (opacity, translateY, scale); useToastTransition eases both the slide-in enter and the auto-dismiss exit. Variants default/success/error change the leading icon and its color.

name: toggle-group
title: UI Toggle Group
desc: A segmented control whose active value is a pure function of the timeline; a raised thumb SLIDES between segments (position + width derived from a float indicator offset, no jumps) and the labels crossfade color via mixOklch. The tabs precedent without content panels.

name: toggle-on
title: Toggle on
desc: A large switch flips on and lights the stage as the Auto-captions label turns On.

name: token-tags
title: Token Tags
desc: The rest of the UI washes out and leader lines run from elements to dark chips naming the design tokens they use.

name: toolbar-unfurl
title: Toolbar Unfurl
desc: A round tap button unfurls into a tool strip while captions list each tool over a glowing ribbon.

name: tooltip
title: UI Tooltip
desc: A tooltip whose hidden/visible state is a pure function of the timeline. The Tooltip renderer is a pure function of a TooltipStyle (opacity, scale, translate); useTooltipTransition eases both the show and the hide. The static `side` prop sets the enter translate axis and the arrow placement.

name: top-down-letters
title: Top-Down Letters
desc: Letters descend from above in a pronounced staircase, one symbol at a time, with zero blur.

name: topo-lines
title: Topo Lines
desc: Topographic contour lines around a few seeded peaks breathe and shift in a seamless loop, one contour picked out in the accent color.

name: torn-edge
title: Torn Edge
desc: A torn paper sheet rips away to reveal a bold headline printed on the gradient stage.

name: tracking-in
title: Tracking In
desc: Letter-spacing collapses and blur clears with a springy motion.

name: transit-lines
title: Transit Lines
desc: Metro-map lines converge on a hub station that resolves into the logo as the next stop.

name: treemap-split
title: Treemap Split
desc: A treemap splits into category tiles, the biggest tile in gradient with a 38% label.

name: trim-burst
title: Trim Burst
desc: A ring of short straight strokes shoots out from a point like Trim Paths: each end races ahead on a hard-braking ease-out while its start holds, then chases it on a smoother ease-in-out, so every stroke grows, travels and zips shut at its outer distance.

name: truchet-flip
title: Truchet Flip
desc: Quarter-circle Truchet tiles snap a quarter turn as a wave crosses the grid, rerouting continuous lines until they settle into concentric loops, a calm field, or a circle of small rings.

name: turnabout
title: Turnabout
desc: "The video works for you." with the last word turned to an orange accent.

name: turntable
title: Turntable
desc: A product card spins on an invisible turntable through front, edge and back in real 3D, with face shading and a breathing floor shadow.

name: tv-power-off
title: TV Power Off
desc: End a scene the way a tube does: the picture collapses into a glowing horizontal line, the line pinches to a phosphor dot, the dot decays, and the frame is left dead black.

name: two-hit
title: Two Hit
desc: A two-hit headline, "Streaming now.", in white then blue, right-aligned on black.

name: type-fossil
title: Type Fossil
desc: A readable word carries layers of fine contours, revises itself, then compresses into a clean typographic imprint.

name: type-repeater
title: Type Repeater
desc: An After Effects style repeater on a word, where copies unfold into a tunnel, a spiral or a fan behind it, breathe, then fold back into the word.

name: type-wall
title: Type Wall
desc: Rows of one word fill the frame, run in alternating directions at different speeds in heavy, narrow and outline faces, with an accent band through the middle.

name: typed-split-wipe
title: Typed Split Wipe
desc: A centered cursorless type build holds, then exits through opposing fixed-layout glyph wipes that leave the anchor visible longest.

name: typewriter
title: Typewriter
desc: Character-by-character text reveal with a deterministic blinking cursor.

name: typing-indicator
title: UI Typing Indicator
desc: A continuous typing animation: N dots bounce with a staggered sine wave. A motion atom — it reads the frame and takes color, size, gap, and speed props, defaulting to currentColor so it inherits the bubble it sits in.

name: typo-fix
title: Typo Fix
desc: A misspelled word is caught and corrected in place inside a short line.

name: ui-callout
title: UI Callout
desc: Callout cards route to targets on a product screen with connecting leader lines.

name: uncomment-line
title: Uncomment Line
desc: Three lines are uncommented one by one in code style: 'Fork the scenes. Change anything. Own the cut.'.

name: underwater-ripple
title: Underwater Ripple
desc: Hold a scene under moving water: every pixel is read through a layered refraction field that closes on a whole number of cycles, with colour fringing where the water bends hardest.

name: unit-grid
title: Unit Grid
desc: A 10x10 dot grid lights up 33 dots next to a 33 / 100 stat line.

name: unmask-line
title: Unmask Line
desc: A monospace line is unmasked letter by letter, 'Out of stealth.', the last word in green.

name: up-close
title: Up Close
desc: A screenshot zooms close, captioned "Up close, it's code. From here, it's your launch.".

name: uptime-strip
title: Uptime Strip
desc: A strip of ticks fills in green while 99.99% uptime types out beside an italic word.

name: upvote-burst
title: Upvote Burst
desc: A launch leaderboard climbs and a #1 Product of the Day badge stamps in.

name: url-bar-cta
title: URL Bar CTA
desc: A browser window with a landing page where the cursor clicks the Get started button.

name: v0
title: v0
desc: Animated Vercel v0 composer — types a prompt into the dark textarea and the mic button morphs into a send button. Dark/light themes.

name: value-swap
title: Value Swap
desc: Swaps a value in place with a vertical slide — the old value exits up as the new one enters from below while an invisible sizer keeps the width stable.

name: venetian-blinds
title: Venetian Blinds
desc: The outgoing scene splits into horizontal slats that turn edge-on in a staggered ripple, revealing the next scene behind them.

name: venn-merge
title: Venn Merge
desc: Two circles labelled Design and Code overlap, and the lens fills with the logo.

name: verbed
title: Verbed
desc: A dictionary entry for "remocn" with senses, inflections and an example sentence.

name: version-hero
title: Version Hero
desc: A chrome 2.0 version numeral rises inside a glowing ring with Now available beneath.

name: versus-split
title: Versus Split
desc: A diagonal split frames remocn against the old way with stat rows for time, cost and rounds.

name: vhs-filter
title: VHS Filter
desc: Hold a scene under analog tape: chroma bleeds sideways off every edge, rows wobble out of line, the bottom of the frame tears on the head switch, and luma noise settles over all of it.

name: video-call
title: Video Call
desc: A video call shares a dashboard while participants send floating emoji reactions.

name: video-watch-page
title: Video Watch Page
desc: A video watch page with a player, related list and comments.

name: voice-agent
title: Voice Agent
desc: A voice agent call transcript streams, handles an interruption and books a table.

name: waitlist-swarm
title: Waitlist Swarm
desc: Cursors and avatar dots swarm to form an R while the waitlist count rolls up.

name: wake-wipe
title: Wake Wipe
desc: A wake-like wipe reveals 'Ship the launch video today.' with a gradient accent word.

name: walkout-name
title: Walkout Name
desc: A fighter-style name stack, 'The Launch Kid', with a light slash, record and a serif nickname.
